<analysis>
The user's active request is a confirmed build brief (in Chinese) for a cute kitty-catching-fish web game: 60-second arcade game, cat moves at screen bottom catching 3 fish types (yellow +10, blue +20, gold +50), avoiding 2 trash types (can −10 +1.5s slowdown, boot −20 +2.5s slowdown), increasing difficulty, scoring/combo/settlement screen, warm cartoon art, light music, touch+keyboard+mouse, landscape, Web/React/2D. Scope: one complete playable version with one cat, three fish, two trash, one 60s level, scoring/settlement, warm BGM and SFX. User language and in-game language: Chinese. Resource library optional. Instructions demand autonomous execution, visual references before bulk production using structured uiReference/ui-board-plan, implementation AND runtime checks in same assignment, no stopping at visual handoff.

I have completed: (1) all eight design docs; (2) four AI images generated and inspected (ui-board, scene-board, bg-kitchen via requestId kittyfish-bg-v2 after v1 got stuck 502/409 unknown, sprites via kittyfish-sprites-v2 after v1 503/502); (3) sprite alpha measured via Python connected-component analysis, six frames cropped via media.mjs and packed into atlas assets/runtime/sprites.png + sprites.atlas.json; bg copied to assets/runtime/bg.png; (4) 12 WAVs rendered via resources.mjs audio recipe (initial failure: sine must use type:"oscillator"); (5) all 14 resources registered into Asset Manifest after multiple schema fixes; (6) content JSON rewritten to beegame-content-package.v2 / beegame-content.v1 schema, --current and --design-layouts and --scene-layouts all pass; index revision finalized (documentRevision 9ae049f46b79...); (7) code: package.json, vite.config.js, index.html, src/game/config.js, input.js, content-client.js, audio.js, engine.js just written.

Remaining: src/main.jsx, App.jsx, components (GameCanvas/Hud/Menu/PauseDialog/ResultScreen/Countdown/OrientationGate), styles.css, content-driven UI renderer; Vite plugin to copy content/ and assets/runtime/ + asset-manifest + assets/manifest into dist; bun install; build; measure.mjs with consumption probes; preview interactive tests and screenshots at landscape + portrait gate; evidence in handoff.

Key errors resolved (don't repeat): (a) image upstream 502 leaves receipt stuck "unknown" — same requestId retry returns 409; used new requestId (v2) and succeeded, settled 4 credits each; (b) media.mjs atlas output must be under assets/ (rejected public/assets/runtime); (c) audio recipe sine sources must be {"type":"oscillator","waveform":"sine"}; (d) resource registration: selection_reason must be array, source object only accepts web form (omit for agent-authored), acquisition_profile needs dimensions ["2D"], asset_kinds ["image"]/["sprite-atlas"]/["audio-clip"], styles array; resource dimension field "2D" not "2d"; (e) content docs: no top-level "name"; image component needs canvas ancestor + rect-transform + canvas-renderer; canvas node itself needs rect-transform; UI root needs data.orientation "Landscape", referenceResolution, targetViewports as [[w,h]] pairs including reference size, minimumControlSize; fixed 1280 layouts fail on small phone viewports so targetViewports restricted to [[1280,720],[1920,1080]] with runtime letterbox scaling; (f) index revisions must come from --package-metadata, not invented.

Important design/code decision recorded in scene zones (authoritative): catchLine y=560, basketHalfWidth=44, catHome (640,620), catDrawnSize 153×190 — I edited config.js to match but need to verify config.js consistency (I changed CATCH fallback to y560/halfW44 and CAT.width 153 height 190). Engine draws cat with bottom=706; cat sprite actual frame is 332×412 (ratio 0.806), drawn w derived = 190*0.806 ≈ 153.

engine.js known issues to check when integrating: slowed uses performance.now()/1000 vs slowUntil also performance.now/1000 — consistent; getHud slowdown ratio may divide oddly; pop animation dy computed then overwritten (harmless); missed fish sets mood 'sad' but _renderCat only handles dizzy filter (normal/happy drawn same visually) — acceptable; audio manager unlock/startBgm flow needs wiring; countdown 3-2-1 state machine, pause on blur, result stats and high score localStorage still to implement in App.

Measure tool facts: run node ".beegame/tmp/goal-tools-S66Tsk/measure.mjs" --request <stable-id> --artifact dist; supports --consumption-json with uiProbes (coordinateRoot:"#logical-root" recommended since we scale a 1280×720 fixed logical root), sceneProbes, audioProbes. preview.mjs --run test.mjs for interaction tests, viewport snapshots. Content must be fetchable from dist (Vite publicDir is public/ — but runtime assets live in assets/runtime and content/ at project root; simplest is configure Vite publicDir to include them via plugin copying content/ and assets/ into dist on build, note measure replaces only artifact folder and runs package.json build).
</analysis>

<summary>
1. Current work and constraints:
Active request: autonomously build the confirmed Chinese game "小猫接鱼" — Web, React, 2D cartoon, landscape, arcade. One complete playable: cat moved by touch/keyboard(←→/AD)/mouse catches falling fish (yellow +10, blue +20, gold +50), avoids trash (can −10 +1.5s slow, boot −20 +2.5s slow); spawn speed/density ramp over a fixed 60s; combo bonus every 5 catches (+5); missed fish don't end game but reduce settlement bonus (catch-rate tiers +150/+80/+30/0); result screen with stats, high score, restart/home; warm looping BGM + full SFX; responsive landscape with portrait gate. UI language: Chinese; assistant replies Chinese. Resource library optional. Constraints: save/inspect full-screen UI references (structured uiReference + ui-board-plan) and scene/prop references BEFORE bulk production; don't precommit image count, don't stop at visual-direction handoff, don't request second authorization; preserve explicit user choices; ask when material choice/authorization missing; never claim unperformed checks/acceptance; bridges expire end of turn; asset generation is billed (cost quote read-only; stable requestId for recovery; errors are not empty results). BGS evidence currently says deliveryEligible:false (no runtime verification yet).

2. Unresolved work:
- Finish React app code: src/main.jsx, src/App.jsx (state machine menu→countdown→playing→paused→result; 3-2-1 countdown ~0.7s each with sfx-count/sfx-go; auto-pause on window blur; high score localStorage key kitty-fish-highscore-v1; mute persisted), components GameCanvas/Hud/Menu/PauseDialog/ResultScreen/Countdown/OrientationGate, generic content-driven UI renderer consuming content/ui/*.json (bindings text/enabled + onAction for game.start/pause/resume/restart/home, ui.toggle-mute), styles.css.
- Build plumbing: bun install (network works; react@19.3.0 tested in tmp), ensure dist contains content/ and assets/ (asset-manifest.json, manifest/, runtime/ — media rejects outputs outside assets/, so runtime assets are at project assets/runtime, not public/; add Vite copy plugin), then `bun run build`.
- Runtime verification (mandatory, none done yet): measure.mjs --artifact dist with --consumption-json (uiProbes using coordinateRoot:"#logical-root" for #play/#resume/#play-again clicks and geometry, sceneProbes on canvas for background node pixel causality, audioProbes for BGM start/stop); preview.mjs --run interaction test (start→countdown→fast game via engine.debugFastForward or simulated time→result screen appears with score/stats); snapshots at 1280×720 landscape and a portrait viewport (orientation gate); inspect actual cat/basket alignment vs catch line y=560 and sprite visuals; verify audio element actually plays.
- Unverified: real-time listening/music quality (explicitly out of automated acceptance per AUDIO_DESIGN); gameplay feel/balance; sprite in-game appearance at runtime; no build or browser smoke has run.
- Paid outcomes: all four image generations settled successfully (ui/scene/bg 4 credits each = 12 at 1536x1024, sprites 3 credits at 1024x1024; total 15 credits). Failed requestIds kittyfish-bg-v1 (502 then 409 stuck-unknown, no delivery) and kittyfish-sprites-v1 (503/502, no delivery) were abandoned in favor of v2 — do not retry v1 ids.

3. Saved work and evidence:
- docs/: GDD.md, TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md, ART_DIRECTION.md, AUDIO_DESIGN.md, UI_UX_SPEC.md, LEVEL_SCENE_DESIGN.md, BALANCE_DESIGN.md, ASSET_PLAN.md.
- Reference images (reference only, not runtime): assets/visual/ui-board.png (2×2 board, 1536×1024, requestId kittyfish-uiboard-v1, inspected: 4 screens warm/on-layout), assets/visual/scene-board.png (kitchen+cat+3 fish+can+boot, kittyfish-sceneboard-v1, inspected).
- Runtime art: assets/source/bg-kitchen.png (bg v2, inspected: no characters/UI), assets/source/sprites-raw.png (1024² transparent verified: 67.6% transparent, 6 main connected components + gold-fish sparkles), per-frame crops in assets/source/frames/{cat-basket,fish-yellow,fish-blue,fish-gold,trash-can,trash-boot}.png; packed assets/runtime/sprites.png (830×656) + sprites.atlas.json with frames cat-basket 332×412, fish-yellow 225×225 area 225×154, fish-blue 267×194, fish-gold 231×204, trash-can 163×194, trash-boot 192×240 (edge-copy padding, linear); bg at assets/runtime/bg.png; inspected atlas clean.
- Audio: 12 WAVs in assets/runtime/audio/ (bgm-kitchen 16s loop, sfx catch/golden/trash/miss/dodge/count/go/end/button/pause/record), 44.1kHz stereo, all valid, peakBeforeNormalization max 0.317 (sfx-go), no failures.
- Registered Manifest: assets/asset-manifest.json + assets/manifest/ (requirements req/background-kitchen, req/sprite-atlas, req/audio-bgm, req/audio-sfx; 14 resources ids img/background-kitchen, atlas/sprites root_path sprites.atlas.json file_paths incl png, audio/*). Registration succeeded after schema corrections (see analysis).
- Content (all pass check-content --current, --design-layouts, --scene-layouts 1280×720): content/index.json (schema beegame-content-package.v2, id kitty-fish-catch-v1, dimension 2d, entryScene scene-level1, documentRevision 9ae049f46b79…, assetManifestRevision derived from actual manifest), content/scenes/level1.json (camera orthographic size 360 letterbox, screen-canvas node with rect-transform+canvas, background image node with rect-transform/canvas-renderer/image assetRef img/background-kitchen, gameplay-zones node behavior kittyfish-zones config: spawnBand x96–1184 y−60; catchLine y560 halfHeight26; basketHalfWidth44; catBand x120–1160; catHome 640,620; missLine730; catDrawnSize153×190), content/ui/{menu,hud,countdown,pause,result}.json (beegame-content.v1; roots carry data orientation Landscape, referenceResolution[1280,720], targetViewports [[1280,720],[1920,1080]], minimumControlSize[48,48]; menu cat-hero sprite node assetRef atlas/sprites data.frame cat-basket; actions game.start/pause/resume/restart/home, ui.toggle-mute; bindings score/time/comboLabel/highscore/bonusLabel).
- Code written: package.json (vite5/react19, scripts dev/build/preview), vite.config.js (base './'), index.html; src/game/config.js (authoritative runtime numbers; note fallback CATCH y560/basket44, CAT 153×190, ITEM_DRAW_H, difficulty functions, fishKind/trashKind, bonusForCatchRate), input.js (InputController: keyboard, mouse hover-follow, touch drag, toLogicalX callback), content-client.js (loadGameContent: reads index→docs, manifest modules→resource ids, loads bg/atlas images, extracts zones, audio id→url map; expects /content and /assets served from build base), audio.js (AudioManager: pool of 8, mute localStorage, unlock/startBgm/stopBgm/setBgmVolume/playSfx), engine.js (GameEngine: fixed 1/120 step, canvas 1280×720 ×dpr, spawner, cat keyboard accel/pointer easing/slowdown, catch resolution at y560 with horizontal basket test, combo, floaters/particles/shake, pop-into-basket arc, gold glow, cover bg, shape fallbacks if images missing, getHud/getResult, onFinish/onHud callbacks, debugFastForward for tests, pause/resume/destroy). Engine not yet wired to React or input instance.
- Helper scripts in .beegame/tmp/2c1a725034f7ccfca9da028e/: request JSONs (use v2 ids), alpha_bounds.py, components.py (writes sprite-bounds.json), media-images/media-atlas(2).json, audio-recipe2.json (corrected), register.json (final working form).

4. Where to continue:
Next precise step: write src/main.jsx + src/App.jsx and UI components/styles that (a) call loadGameContent('.') on boot with loading state, (b) render #logical-root fixed 1280×720 scaled/letterboxed via CSS transform (layout helper needed) containing the GameCanvas (engine attaches InputController with toLogicalX using the scale) and DOM overlays rendered from the fetched content/ui JSON documents, (c) implement the full state machine, countdown, pause (incl. blur), result stats + bonus label + high score, mute, portrait gate, BGM duck to 0.4 on result and stop on home, sfx on catch/golden/trash/miss/dodge/count/go/end/button/pause/record (record sfx when new high score). Then add a Vite plugin (or publicDir strategy) so `bun run build` copies content/, assets/runtime/, assets/asset-manifest.json and assets/manifest/ into dist (content-client fetches `./content/index.json`, `./assets/asset-manifest.json`, manifest module files listed under manifest.modules.resources — verify those module paths after build). Then bun install, bun run build, run measure.mjs --request with a fresh stable id --artifact dist plus consumption JSON (uiProbes coordinateRoot #logical-root clicking #play etc., sceneProbe background, audioProbe BGM), and preview.mjs --run for gameplay/result/portrait evidence; inspect screenshots for basket/catch-line alignment (y=560, basket half-width 44 vs drawn cat) and gold/trash readability. Read existing files before editing; do not regenerate images/audio or re-register resources (manifest revisions are hashed and content index already binds the current manifest revision — replacing assets would require re-registration and index revision refresh).
</summary>
